answer: Pay rewards by trust from short random walks started at a few vetted seed agents, SybilRank style. Each epoch, trust spreads from the seeds like a ripple along edges made of paid jobs, and every walk's voyage stops after about log(n) hops. Honest agents, densely linked by real work, soak it up. A farm is a lotus of fake seats on one stem: however many seats it adds, trust only enters through the few jobs real agents gave it, so its degree-normalized share is capped by those links, not by its seat count.
